notes: «عن عبد الله، مولى أسماء بنت أبي بكر» names the mawla (freedman) of Asma: the name is «عبد الله»; the patron phrase and «وكان خال ولد عطاء» are descriptions, left out
the report is the mawla's own account of carrying Asma's question to Ibn Umar: he is the last link; Asma, Ibn Umar and Umar are in the story (scene or quoted speech), not links
«عبد الله» is the second occurrence in the text (the first is in «خالد بن عبد الله»)
